notes: Ghostcast 2.2.95 - linking fixed for good: Ghostcast could stay on Linking for ever (a wrong stretch guess made at the login screen was kept); it now never guesses while nothing of Ghostcast is on the game's screen and keeps a guess only when everything reads. It links about half a second after logging in, a /reload or a loading screen, about 1 second after it starts while you play, and at once after the game was minimized. No needless /reload. New start screen music. The addon updates itself once (one UI reload).
